result.title: Monte Alén National Park - Wikipedia
result.content: Monte Alén National Park (Spanish: Parque nacional de Monte Alén) is located near the center of Equatorial Guinea. It was established in 1990. With an area of 2,000 km2 (770 sq mi), [1] it is the country's largest national park. [2] The goliath frog, one of the prominent amphibians found in the park, is the biggest frog in the world; hunting it is prohibited. [3][4]
